title: Plus Size Slit Crepe Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this stunning plus-size evening dress! Crafted from luxurious crepe fabric, it features a sultry thigh-high slit and a flattering silhouette that hugs your curves. Perfect for formal events, galas, or weddings, this dress exudes elegance and confidence.


Tips: Made of high-stretch fabric with at least 2 inches of stretch.
Select your size based on the standard size chart.
If there is a significant difference between your bust, waist, and hip measurements, prioritize the bust measurement when choosing.
For a tighter fit, please choose one size smaller.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises crepe.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
